Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background

Interface MenuConditionContext

public interface MenuConditionContext
What an add-on condition, value or resolver is asked about: one viewer, the menu they are opening or looking at, and the moment the menu is being decided.

A context is only valid during the call it is passed to, which always runs on the main thread. Keep the work quick: it runs every time the menu opens or redraws.

Since:
